findings.title: Stale cancellation policy contradicts spec 005
findings.why: Spec 001 records a policy of no refund if cancelled less than 24h before start, otherwise a full refund. Spec 005 and `cancel` in src/index.ts implement a prorated refund instead. Spec 001 also says cancellation is out of scope, and its plan.md describes midnight-only date parsing, which hourly rentals replaced. The docs disagree with each other and with the code.

findings.title: Computed total is not checked for safe-integer overflow
findings.why: `addEquipment` checks each price with `Number.isSafeInteger`. The products `days * dailyPrice`, `fullPrice * 9`, and `hours * hourlyPrice` are not checked. With a very large price or a very long period, the total can exceed 2^53 and lose precision. The same applies to `booking.total * remainingHours` in `cancel`. The result is then not an exact integer number of cents, which the spec requires.
